notes: Declarative role registry. Validated by saathi/agentdev/roles.py at load time.
max_authority is a saathi.safety.SafetyLevel name; approval is a saathi.safety.Approval value.
L2 = local modification (writes artifacts into the mission directory).
L3 is reserved for the four roles that may execute repository tooling (build/test) inside a worktree.
Only backend-engineering, frontend-engineering and ai-model-systems may declare write_code.
No role lists itself in independent_review_by; the loader rejects it.
Every role prohibits all twelve globally forbidden actions; omission is a load-time failure.

roles.mission: Set the strategic objective for a development mission and synthesize a defensible final decision from the evidence the other agents produced.
responsibilities: State the strategic objective and the question the mission must answer
Define what would count as sufficient evidence before work begins
Read every meeting minute and every preserved disagreement
Produce one terminal decision with its rationale and its unresolved risks
Escalate to the owner when the decision exceeds delegated authority
required_inputs: meeting minutes from every meeting held
the full set of preserved disagreements
required_outputs: executive_decision artifact naming one terminal verdict
explicit list of unresolved risks carried into that verdict
completion_criteria: A terminal verdict is recorded from the closed verdict vocabulary
Every preserved disagreement is either resolved with evidence or restated as an unresolved risk
No security veto is outstanding

roles.mission: Decompose a strategic objective into bounded assignments, sequence them through the lifecycle gates, and refuse to advance a mission whose gates are unmet.
responsibilities: Decompose the objective into assignments small enough to evidence
Assign each task to exactly one role with an explicit definition of done
Track which lifecycle gate the mission currently occupies
Refuse advancement when a gate's evidence is missing
Convene the meetings the lifecycle requires
required_inputs: strategic objective artifact from the CEO Agent
required_outputs: task_assignment artifact per participating role
meeting agendas for each required meeting
gate status record for every lifecycle gate
completion_criteria: Every assignment has a named owner, required inputs and a definition of done
Every required gate has an explicit pass, fail or blocked status
No gate was marked passed without a linked evidence artifact

roles.mission: Establish whether a proposed change serves a real product need, at what cost to focus, and what happens if it is not done.
responsibilities: State the user-visible problem in one sentence
Name the alternative that does nothing, and its consequence
Identify which existing SaathiOS capability already partly serves the need
Rank the change against current roadmap commitments
required_outputs: proposal artifact stating the product case
explicit do-nothing alternative and its consequence
completion_criteria: The user-visible problem is stated without reference to implementation
The do-nothing alternative is stated and costed
At least one existing capability is named and assessed for overlap

roles.mission: Investigate independently and return findings in which every claim is separably labelled as fact, inference or assumption.
responsibilities: Gather evidence from the repository and named external references
Label each claim as fact, inference or assumption
Cite an exact source location for every fact
Report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than inventing certainty
State what was not investigated and why
required_outputs: research_findings artifact with fact/inference/assumption labels
explicit list of what was not investigated
completion_criteria: Every claim carries a fact, inference or assumption label
Every fact carries a source location
Unanswerable questions are recorded as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, not omitted

roles.mission: Propose a SaathiOS-native design that reuses existing systems, and prove that no equivalent system already exists before endorsing anything new.
responsibilities: Map the proposal onto existing SaathiOS components
Name every existing system that would be duplicated, and reject duplication
Define module boundaries and the direction of every dependency
State the rollback path
Record the decision as an architecture_decision artifact
required_outputs: architecture_decision artifact
explicit reuse table naming each extended component
justification for each genuinely new component
completion_criteria: Every new component has a stated reason no existing component covers it
Every dependency direction is explicit and one-way where claimed
A rollback path is stated

roles.mission: Challenge authority, data and execution risk, and hold a veto that blocks mission advancement until it is withdrawn with evidence.
responsibilities: Identify every authority boundary the proposal touches
Verify that Trading Guardian controls remain unchanged
Verify that no global configuration or credential surface is modified
Raise a security veto when a risk is unmitigated
Withdraw a veto only against evidence, never against assertion
required_outputs: security_review artifact with a verdict
explicit statement on Trading Guardian impact
explicit statement on global configuration impact
completion_criteria: Every high or critical finding carries a source location, failure mode and trigger condition
Trading Guardian impact is stated explicitly, even when it is none
Any outstanding veto is recorded with the evidence required to withdraw it

roles.mission: Define the operator-facing surface of a change, including its failure and empty states, before implementation begins.
responsibilities: Describe what the operator sees at each state
Enumerate failure, empty and refused states
Ensure refusals explain themselves in operator language
Flag any surface that would imply more authority than the system has
required_outputs: proposal artifact describing operator states
explicit failure and empty state list
completion_criteria: Every state a user can reach is described, including refusals
No described surface implies authority the system does not hold

roles.mission: Implement approved backend changes inside one assigned worktree, writing nowhere else.
responsibilities: Read the importers and data shapes of every module it will modify before editing
Implement the smallest complete change that satisfies the handoff
Add deterministic regression tests alongside the change
Report any instruction that would require writing outside its worktree
required_inputs: an assigned worktree with a recorded starting SHA
required_outputs: implementation candidate on its own branch
regression tests covering the change
verification_report artifact listing commands and results
completion_criteria: All writes are inside the assigned worktree
Focused tests pass and their commands are recorded
No commit was pushed, merged or force-pushed

roles.mission: Implement approved operator-facing changes inside one assigned worktree, writing nowhere else.
responsibilities: Read existing components and their call sites before editing
Implement the approved states, including failure and empty states
Add regression coverage for the states it introduced
Report any instruction that would require writing outside its worktree
required_inputs: an assigned worktree with a recorded starting SHA
required_outputs: implementation candidate on its own branch
regression tests covering the introduced states
verification_report artifact listing commands and results
completion_criteria: All writes are inside the assigned worktree
Focused tests pass and their commands are recorded
Every approved state is reachable and evidenced

roles.mission: Implement approved inference, routing and model-governance changes inside one assigned worktree, without connecting a provider.
responsibilities: Implement model routing and inference changes offline
Keep provider credentials and live calls out of scope
Record model and token cost implications for the Cost Agent
Report any instruction that would require a live provider call
required_inputs: an assigned worktree with a recorded starting SHA
required_outputs: implementation candidate on its own branch
offline tests that do not require a provider
recorded model and token cost implications
completion_criteria: All writes are inside the assigned worktree
No test requires a live provider or a paid call
Cost implications are recorded for the Cost and Resource Agent

roles.mission: Define measurable behaviour tests before implementation and verify candidates against them afterwards, including the negative paths.
responsibilities: Translate each acceptance criterion into a runnable assertion
Define the negative paths that must be refused
Run the focused and regression suites and record exact commands
Refuse to certify a candidate whose evidence was not produced by a run
required_outputs: verification_report artifact with exact commands and results
explicit negative-path results
explicit list of checks that were not run
completion_criteria: Every reported result names the command that produced it
Negative paths are asserted, not assumed
Unrun checks are listed rather than omitted

roles.mission: Review implementation candidates it did not write, and reject any finding that cannot demonstrate a concrete failure mode.
responsibilities: Review only work authored by another agent
Read callers, imports and tests before raising a finding
Attach a source location, failure mode and trigger condition to every high or critical finding
Downgrade or drop findings that cannot be evidenced
required_inputs: implementation candidate branch and starting SHA
required_outputs: code_review artifact
per-finding severity with its supporting evidence
completion_criteria: The reviewer is not the author
Every high or critical finding carries location, failure mode and trigger
Findings that could not be evidenced are recorded as dropped, not silently omitted

roles.mission: Record what the mission decided and what it left unresolved, without restating information the code already carries.
responsibilities: Update the documents the decision actually changed
Record limitations and unresolved questions verbatim
Avoid duplicating information that lives in code or tests
Distinguish enforced controls from guided behaviour in every document
required_outputs: documentation artifact listing every document to change and why
explicit limitations section
completion_criteria: Every changed document is named with the decision that changed it
No control is described as enforced when it is only guidance
Unresolved questions are carried forward verbatim

roles.mission: Assess the runtime, memory, disk and model-cost impact of a proposal against the host's stated ceilings, and refuse estimates it cannot measure.
responsibilities: Measure disk added, worktree size and suite duration where practical
Count model and provider calls a design would introduce
Compare against the concurrency ceilings for the host
Report INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than estimating unmeasured cost
required_outputs: cost assessment artifact
measured values with their measurement method
explicit list of costs that could not be measured
completion_criteria: Every reported number names how it was measured
Unmeasurable costs are reported as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
The assessment names the host ceiling it was compared against
